recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic portrait framed by a thick, orange textile border with repeating geometric step-pyramid motifs. The portrait is tilted diagonally, emerging from a dark background, paired with a two-tier typographic lockup at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant orange border constrains the dark, moody central photograph.
The diagonal tilt of the subject's face creates a dynamic line against the square frame.
The white script text contrasts sharply against the black background for maximum legibility.
coreInvariants: Repeating geometric textile pattern in the border
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Two-tier text hierarchy with script over sans-serif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, tilted approximately 45 degrees towards the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the white script text, moves down the diagonal of the face, and is then contained by the vibrant border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space occupies the upper-right quadrant of the inner frame.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multicolor geometric accents (blue, purple, green, red)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border vs. low saturation, high value contrast in the central portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid brush script paired with a wide, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Connected, varying stroke weight, upright but fluid.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, personal script and rigid, institutional sans-serif.

avoid: Using serif fonts for the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten energy of the primary text.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick orange woven textile border featuring repeating blue and red geometric step-pyramid patterns. Inside the border, place a high-contrast portrait of a person with dark hair, tilted 45 degrees, emerging from a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white brush script text in the top left of the black area. Below it, add a line of all-caps, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text in golden yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the border clearly a woven textile texture?
Is the background behind the text solid black?
Are there two distinct font styles used?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Tactile textile appearance in the border
Strong chiaroscuro lighting in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the border does not bleed into the central image.
Check that the script text is legible against the black.
Verify the geometric patterns are consistent around the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square frame + [Textile Border with Geometric Motif] + [Tilted High-Contrast Portrait] + [Script/Sans-Serif Lockup]
